groups.name: 02_Source (程序源码)
groups.purpose: Read modules in execution order; links keep runtime paths and source fingerprints intact. (按数据到运行顺序查看源码，原路径与指纹保留。)

entries.label: 01_data.py
entries.purpose: Data module: data.py (日历、历史行情增量更新、批量更新及报价获取。)

entries.label: 02_worker.py
entries.purpose: Data module: worker.py (独立网络工作进程，供主程序限制请求耗时、隔离网络故障。)

entries.label: 03_connections.py
entries.purpose: Data module: connections.py (腾讯/新浪等行情交叉检查、停牌信息、账户快照和费用资料导入；不发送真实订单。)

entries.label: 04_history_sources.py
entries.purpose: Data module: history_sources.py (历史数据及执行状态证据获取，保留来源；未知公司行动不当作没有发生。)

entries.label: 05_public_history.py
entries.purpose: Data module: public_history.py (BaoStock 历史数据补充和交叉校验；补齐行情不代表已经具备成交证据。)

entries.label: 06_factors.py
entries.purpose: Data module: factors.py (行业、估值、财务、宏观等公开因子快照采集和审计。)

entries.label: 07_indices.py
entries.purpose: Data module: indices.py (指数数据更新、市场环境特征及指数特征研究比较。)

entries.label: 08_compare.py
entries.purpose: Data module: compare.py (比较保留的东方财富基准与标准化腾讯数据，检查差异。)

entries.label: 09_data_sources__database.py
entries.purpose: Data module: data_sources/database.py (把校验后的行情快照同步到 SQLite 数据库，避免重复导入。)

entries.label: 10_data_sources__broker_records.py
entries.purpose: Data module: data_sources/broker_records.py (读取本地券商 CSV 导出记录；导入文件不等于实时连接券商。)

entries.label: 11_intraday_data.py
entries.purpose: Data module: intraday_data.py (盘中模拟所需的报价、交易日和公司行动参考资料及质量检查。)

entries.label: 12_intraday_events.py
entries.purpose: Data module: intraday_events.py (新闻及公告采集、去重、发布时间/首次观察时间记录和规则分类；不等于阅读全部公告全文。)

entries.label: 01_intraday_inference.py
entries.purpose: Prediction module: intraday_inference.py (读取模型绑定的不可变历史快照，核验版本、哈希与可用时间；复用原系数和公式进行盘中研究推理。)

entries.label: 02_forecast.py
entries.purpose: Prediction module: forecast.py (核心收益预测：构建技术特征与未来收益标签、拟合 Ridge、产生预测及基础研究配置。)

entries.label: 03_seven_metrics.py
entries.purpose: Prediction module: seven_metrics.py (汇总七项研究指标，结合九因素计算综合评分并导出结果；评分本身不授予交易资格。)

entries.label: 04_probability_calibration.py
entries.purpose: Prediction module: probability_calibration.py (按时间顺序校准上涨概率，使用独立日期块，检查概率估计是否具有验证依据。)

entries.label: 05_model_candidates.py
entries.purpose: Prediction module: model_candidates.py (固定规格的 AR、Lasso、LightGBM、XGBoost 候选模型及已选择模型读取。)

entries.label: 06_risk_models.py
entries.purpose: Prediction module: risk_models.py (GARCH 波动率与 HMM 市场状态研究、风险比较和协方差调整；通过检查才可应用相应结果。)

entries.label: 07_models____init__.py
entries.purpose: Prediction module: models/__init__.py (统一暴露既有特征、拟合和推理函数；这里没有另一套预测算法。)

entries.label: 01_decision.py
entries.purpose: Decision and Risk module: decision.py (组合优化及候选交易计划核心：四种配置方法、费用、现金、单股/行业上限、T+1、股数和交易状态约束。)

entries.label: 02_research_policy.py
entries.purpose: Decision and Risk module: research_policy.py (研究模拟的仓位分配：市场环境影响总仓位，个股结合预测与风险分配；不赋予正式资格。)

entries.label: 03_adaptive_policy.py
entries.purpose: Decision and Risk module: adaptive_policy.py (模型输出后的盘中调整：走势、相对表现、波动和事件修正研究判断，保留原始预测、评分和排名。)

entries.label: 04_risk__risk_control.py
entries.purpose: Decision and Risk module: risk/risk_control.py (独立风险减仓模拟计划，只处理风险卖出方向，不因模型未通过而完全失去风控计划。)

entries.label: 05_strategies__next_session_plan.py
entries.purpose: Decision and Risk module: strategies/next_session_plan.py (下一交易日意向及其条件说明，把收盘后计划与当下能否成交分开。)

entries.label: 06_strategy_experiment.py
entries.purpose: Decision and Risk module: strategy_experiment.py (比较不同风险预算和执行阈值的研究方案，冻结对照输入并记录收益、成本及风险；不训练模型。)

entries.label: 01_paper_account.py
entries.purpose: Execution and Ledger module: paper_account.py (旧策略历史模拟账户（默认隐藏）：冻结计划、模拟执行、持续账本与收益报告；不操作真实资金。)

entries.label: 02_research_paper.py
entries.purpose: Execution and Ledger module: research_paper.py (研究模型预测与独立模拟账户：冻结研究计划、跟踪预测到期并生成报告，不替换正式模型。)

entries.label: 03_research_execution.py
entries.purpose: Execution and Ledger module: research_execution.py (研究模拟执行引擎，按既定风险优先顺序处理减仓，并考虑执行约束。)

entries.label: 04_active_research.py
entries.purpose: Execution and Ledger module: active_research.py (保留的日线研究模拟方案及历史账本，连接研究计划、执行及发布报告。)

entries.label: 05_order_engine.py
entries.purpose: Execution and Ledger module: order_engine.py (动态模拟委托、稳定整手换算、后续报价撮合、T+1、费用及盈亏；无真实券商通道。)

entries.label: 06_active_execution.py
entries.purpose: Execution and Ledger module: active_execution.py (日常研究模拟执行及小额买单净优势检查，考虑实际单笔费用是否划算。)

entries.label: 07_intraday.py
entries.purpose: Execution and Ledger module: intraday.py (盘中对照执行；提供仅修正浮点误差的统一整手股数换算，保留交易与风险条件。)

entries.label: 08_adaptive_intraday.py
entries.purpose: Execution and Ledger module: adaptive_intraday.py (原动态模拟账户与迁移来源，冻结证据保留；当前主账户由 dynamic_service 管理。)

entries.label: 09_execution_replay.py
entries.purpose: Execution and Ledger module: execution_replay.py (按历史交易日重放候选订单，检查费用、涨跌停与交易状态；不能确认成交时不虚构成交。)

entries.label: 01_backtesting__research.py
entries.purpose: Validation module: backtesting/research.py (固定规则的探索性指标、策略模拟和历史研究，与实际执行层分开。)

entries.label: 02_portfolio_validation.py
entries.purpose: Validation module: portfolio_validation.py (滚动样本外比较投资组合方法；使用收益标签的代理评估，不能直接证明实际可成交。)

entries.label: 03_strict_validation.py
entries.purpose: Validation module: strict_validation.py (时间划分、滚动验证、时点对齐、风险收益指标和正式资格检查的基础工具。)

entries.label: 04_validation_engine.py
entries.purpose: Validation module: validation_engine.py (固定规格训练/验证/测试和推理接口；已被查看的历史数据不冒充未触碰测试集。)

entries.label: 05_model_research.py
entries.purpose: Validation module: model_research.py (新旧候选模型的配对历史比较、显著性检验及前瞻影子预测记录。)

entries.label: 06_iteration.py
entries.purpose: Fingerprint-bound candidate search and legacy cadence retained for audit; current CLI scheduling is in daily_iteration.py. (保留原候选算法与旧调度供指纹审计，当前日常调度见 daily_iteration.py。)

entries.label: daily_iteration.py
entries.purpose: Daily entry for per-slot trials; retains the legacy frozen scheduler. (分组试用的每日入口，保留旧版冻结调度兼容实现。)

entries.label: 07_lifecycle.py
entries.purpose: Validation module: lifecycle.py (Champion–Challenger 生命周期：实验冻结、预测到期、独立验收、晋升、资格撤销及正式模型准入。)

entries.label: 08_model_monitor.py
entries.purpose: Validation module: model_monitor.py (持续记录预测误差、评估模型状态，必要时限制不再满足要求的模型。)

entries.label: 09_evaluation__prediction_quality.py
entries.purpose: Validation module: evaluation/prediction_quality.py (不可随意改写的预测与实际结果记录，计算到期误差及统计质量；本身不是交易开关。)

entries.label: 10_evaluation__factor_research.py
entries.purpose: Validation module: evaluation/factor_research.py (按信息发布时间对齐因子并进行研究比较；诊断回测不直接晋升正式模型。)

entries.label: 11_evaluation__validation_readiness.py
entries.purpose: Validation module: evaluation/validation_readiness.py (解释模型还缺哪些验证条件，不降低门槛、不承诺何时必定通过。)

entries.label: 12_evaluation__connection_health.py
entries.purpose: Validation module: evaluation/connection_health.py (汇总数据连接及无人值守流程准备状态，保存检查证据。)

entries.label: 01_reporting__plain_chinese.py
entries.purpose: Reporting module: plain_chinese.py (报告中文阅读层，解释委托撤销、数据快照及模型校验状态；不改变原始数值与记录。)

entries.label: 02_reporting__report.py
